purpose: Record and freeze a response-independent metadata normalization after the first Illinois Stage0 run stopped solely because the Dryad REST title encodes the species name inside an HTML em tag.

first_run.raw_title: Camera trap detections and environmental covariates for modeling scale-dependent coyote (Canis latrans) site-use intensity across Illinois, USA (2021–2024)
first_run.stopping_reason: presentational HTML markup in otherwise matching public dataset title

amendment.allowed_normalization: strip HTML tags from Dryad title, unescape HTML entities, collapse whitespace, then require exact equality to the already frozen plain-text title

retry_authorization: one Stage0 retry under the frozen metadata-only normalization; any subsequent substantive source/schema/transport/geometry failure is terminal for this Illinois attempt
